title: Emrys and the Sigil
author: Silas Winterbourne
blurb: Ada Yarrow, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
